subject: [PATCH 2/4] selftests/mm: check sub-PMD ranges window by window in check_huge()

2026-09-29.patch_summary: This patch modifies the check_huge() function in selftests/mm to count folios of a specific order within a range by checking each window individually, rather than counting all folios and comparing the total count to the number of huge pages. This change is necessary for preparing the use of check_huge() in khugepaged.c for collapse_order cases. The patch moves the existing logic from one window into a new function called is_range_backed_by_order(), which checks if a range is backed by folios of a specific order, and uses this function to count the folios within each window.
